title: Fifth-order nonlinear optical properties of through space charge transfer pyridinium salt
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,48109-48115
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07294H, Paper
Open Access

Arturs Bundulis, Kaspars Leduskrasts, Anete Sapne
The fifth-order nonlinear optical (NLO) properties of a through space charge transfer (TSCT) pyridinium organic salt were investigated using the Z-scan technique with a femtosecond laser.
